title: Limits on One Draft by Method on File - TRICARE Prime
content:
One draft through the payment method on file of a fee-bearing TRICARE Prime enrollment is limited by that method:

| Method on file | The account shows payments collected through it | One draft draws at most |
|---|---|---|
| recurring card | yes | 2 regular installments |
| electronic funds transfer | yes | 3 regular installments |
| recurring card or electronic funds transfer | no | the whole open amount |
| allotment | - | the whole open amount |

## Hypothetical figures (regular installment 40.39, open amount 300.00)

- Recurring card with earlier card collections on the account: at most 80.78.
- Electronic funds transfer with earlier transfer collections: at most 121.17.
- Allotment: up to the whole 300.00.
